motifs.name: high_twin_peak_massif
motifs.description: Isolate the upper central double mountain massif: two tall rounded peaks rising behind a saddle, with blue-green and ochre washes, layered contour strokes, dark ink texture marks, and the small pine silhouettes on the lower right shoulder of the ridge.

overlapping blue-green and ochre washes
